notes: Reading Road printed 'READING ROAD (HUNT)'; north side is the sheet-148 outline (y~235-258), south side the block line at y~520; it continues east of Broadway (y 215-470). '?' at Sycamore: a narrower street (~38 ft, block lines y 262/400, water pipe at y~326) continues west of Sycamore in the sheet-147 outline, offset ~58 px north of Reading Road's centre; name not printed. Lockport Av.: a 30 ft north leg (x 2131-2237) from Reading Road to the Parkway's ENE leg, and the 80 ft diagonal (centreline through (2278,1475) and (2482,1692)) from the Parkway's bend south-east to Court, whose centreline meets Court's centreline just west of Broadway (Lockport/Court point) and continues into the Court-Broadway crossing. Parkway: E-W leg centre y 975 (block lines 818/1132, 90'); ENE leg centreline through about (1976,935), 80' (sides: SE edge of the filling-station block and NW edge of the Cincinnati Art Publishing block); the ENE leg and Reading Road merge east of x~2440 and both reach Broadway; Broadway/Parkway (T) uses the ENE leg centreline extended. Eggleston Av. (sheet-141 outline, ~88 ft between dashed/solid edges meeting Broadway's east line at y 2283 and 2735, direction about 46 deg SE): point is where its centreline extended meets Broadway's centreline. South Court Street enters Sycamore only from the west (sheet-139 outline, block lines y 2422/2562). East 9th Street is ~44 ft east of Sycamore (3155-3306) but ~58 ft west of it (3152-3357): Sycamore/9th is the centre of the four corners. W. Cheapside (~39 ft, block lines ~1860/2000) and E. Cheapside (~33 ft, block lines ~2210/2320) run Court to 8th either side of the narrow block 5/8; both drift east down the sheet. East 8th Street: only its north block line (y 4346-4372) is on the sheet (paper ends ~4570); crossing y = north line + 117 px (66 ft printed), approximate. The 20 ft L-shaped unnamed alley runs east from Sycamore (between 1615 and 1680) and turns south (between 1717 and 1767) to Court.
